{
  "Select": [
    "assay_chembl_id",
    "target_type",
    "tax_id",
    "canonical_smiles",
    "molecule_chembl_id",
    "standard_type",
    "pchembl_value"
  ],
  "Source": [
    "activities",
    "assays",
    "target_dictionary",
    "compound_structures",
    "molecule_dictionary"
  ],
  "Join": "activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id; activities.tid = target_dictionary.tid AND target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293286'; activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno; activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno",
  "Filter": "activities.type = 'IC50' AND activities.standard_relation = '=' AND activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293286' AND target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606",
  "Sort": [
    "molecule_chembl_id ASC",
    "assay_chembl_id ASC"
  ],
  "Limit": 1000
}
